data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks
data.investment_objective: To achieve long term capital appreciation by predominantly investing in equity and equity related instruments of large, mid and small cap companies. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be realized.
